# Frostrek AI

> Frostrek AI delivers production-ready autonomous AI agents, LLM training, customized applications, workflow automation, and data annotation services for enterprises.

## Core Products & Solutions
- [Frosty AI](https://www.frostrek.ai/products/frosty-ai): Omnichannel intelligent agent for support and sales
- [Voice AI](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/voice-ai): Enterprise-grade AI calling agents and cognitive virtual assistants
- [AI Calling Agent](https://www.frostrek.ai/products/ai-calling-agent): Outbound and inbound voice AI for high-volume support
- [WhatsApp Bot](https://www.frostrek.ai/products/whatsapp-bot): Autonomous chat agents for conversational deployment
- [Manufacturing OS](https://www.frostrek.ai/products/frostrek-manufacturing-os): ERP/SCADA integration and factory AI optimization
- [Manufacturing Intelligence](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/manufacturing-intelligence): AI-driven operational intelligence for factories
- [Custom LLM Fine-Tuning](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/llm-model-training): Managed RLHF alignment and dataset preparation services
- [AI Agents](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/ai-agents): End-to-end intelligent agent development
- [Hiyring](https://www.frostrek.ai/products/hiyring): Next-generation AI recruitment and hiring platform
- [VettEdge](https://www.frostrek.ai/products/vettedge): AI-powered resume and candidate vetting system
- [Web3 & Fintech](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/fintech-custom-wallets): Custom fintech wallets, stablecoin development, and crypto payment integrations
- [E-Commerce (Vedashi)](https://www.frostrek.ai/products/vedashi-ecommerce): Multi-tenant ecommerce and ERP integrations
- [Multivendor Dashboard](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/multivendor-dashboard): Centralized management for multivendor ecommerce platforms
